test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term wrong. Select that wrong term from the given alternatives.

RN42, WU54, BB14, GI28, LP38
solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern for this code is as follows;

The first letter is increased by 5.

The second letter is increased by 7.

Sum of positional values + 10 = Number 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8398e031c3607d4755ccd186685a99efbdfa41faa9041b5bb50e1d6587f2dff5.png] 

In first term:

R = 18, N = 14, 

(18 + 14) + 10 = 32 + 10 = 42

In second term:

W = 23, U = 21, 

(23 + 21) + 10 = 44 + 10 = 54

In third term:

B = 2, B = 2, 

(2 + 2) + 10 = 4 + 10 = 14

In fourth term:

G = 7, I = 9, 

(7 + 9) + 10 = 16 + 10 = 26 ≠ 28

In fifth term:

L = 12, P = 16, 

(12 + 16) + 10 = 28 + 10 = 38

Hence, "**GI28**" is the correct answer.
